verdict.rationale: Bench is a bookkeeping service, so tracking accounts receivable is a fair question to ask of it. Its documented reports cover only income statements, balance sheets, P&L/Top Expenses dashboards and 1099 reports. There is no evidence of AR aging reports or per-customer receivable balances, and the QBO-native option relies on the host QuickBooks platform rather than a Bench capability.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can track accounts receivable with aging reports and per-customer balances
